card.name: Inside dosage-form names
card.fires_on: Partway through or at the end of dosage-form words like film-coated, chewable, rectal, transdermal, disintegrating and granules, usually right before the word tablets, gel, or system.

modes.label: Dosage form endings
modes.description: The ending piece of a dosage-form term, just before the product noun.
modes.example: Oxcarbazepine oral suspension and oxcarbazepine film-co<<ated>> tablets may be interchanged at equal doses

modes.label: Other mid-word pieces
modes.description: Occasional word pieces outside drug labels, such as in a rare adverb or a belt-type name.
modes.example: She sash<<ays>> to the pink brick

card.writes: It seems to push toward word continuations, but the promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and give no clear picture.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of words describing the form of a medicine, like film-coated or chewable tablets.
